{

  "extraction_type": "causal_dependency",
  "proposals": [
    {
      "id": "P001",
      "type": "authority_boundary",
      "source": "Canonical",
      "target": "Derived",
      "direction": "Canonical → Derived",
      "evidence": "OP Derive(Canonical) -> Derived; INV Derived != Canonical",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "DER-001",
        "AUTH-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Canonical is the sole authoritative source for Derived states."
    },
    {
      "id": "P002",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "Commit",
      "target": "Canonical",
      "direction": "Commit → Canonical",
      "evidence": "OP Commit(Canonical, Evidence) -> Canonical'; INV Mutate(Canonical) => Op == Commit",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "AUTH-001",
        "APP-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Commit is the exclusive mutation operator for Canonical state."
    },
    {
      "id": "P003",
      "type": "constrains",
      "source": "Working",
      "target": "Canonical",
      "direction": "Working → Canonical",
      "evidence": "INV Working.authoritative == false; INV Candidate.authoritative == false",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "related_invariants": [
        "AUTH-002"
      ],
      "notes": "Non-authoritative types cannot mutate Canonical."
    },
    {
      "id": "P004",
      "type": "depends_on",
      "source": "Derived",
      "target": "Canonical",
      "direction": "Derived → Canonical",
      "evidence": "OP Derive(Canonical) -> Derived; INV DER-001: dependencies(target) = {source}",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "DER-001",
        "PUR-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Derived state depends exclusively on Canonical source."
    },
    {
      "id": "P005",
      "type": "invariant",
      "source": "HistoryStore",
      "target": "APP-001",
      "direction": "HistoryStore → APP-001",
      "evidence": "AXIOM: APP-001(HistoryStore); INV APP-001: append_only(target)",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "APP-001"
      ],
      "notes": "HistoryStore must strictly adhere to append-only invariants."
    },
    {
      "id": "P006",
      "type": "invariant",
      "source": "HistoryStore",
      "target": "AUTH-001",
      "direction": "HistoryStore → AUTH-001",
      "evidence": "AXIOM: AUTH-001(HistoryStore, Causal)",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": [
        "AUTH-001"
      ],
      "notes": "HistoryStore holds Causal Authority."
    },
    {
      "id": "P007",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "PUR-001",
      "target": "Derive",
      "direction": "PUR-001 → Derive",
      "evidence": "PRE Derive : Pure | Deterministic; INV_DEF PUR-001: pure(f: Function)",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "related_invariants": [
        "PUR-001",
        "DET-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Derivation operation must be pure and deterministic."
    },
    {
      "id": "P008",
      "type": "constrains",
      "source": "Evidence",
      "target": "Commit",
      "direction": "Evidence → Commit",
      "evidence": "OP Commit(Canonical, Evidence) -> Canonical'; INV Evidence.causal_order == true",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "related_invariants": [
        "APP-001"
      ],
      "notes": "Evidence provided to Commit must maintain causal order."
    }
  ],
  "key_invariants_detected": [
    "PUR-001",

    "APP-001",
    "REP-001",
    "REP-002",

    "Canonical (Authoritative)",
    "Derived (NonAuthoritative)",
    "Working (NonAuthoritative)",
    "External (NonAuthoritative)",
    "Candidate (NonAuthoritative)"

  "open_questions": [
    "How is 'causal_order' of Evidence strictly enforced during Commit?",
    "What is the specific mechanism for 'Deferred' or 'Rejected' candidates to interact with the Canonical store without mutation?",
    "Does 'Derive' imply a snapshot or a live stream of Canonical data?"
  ]
